sections.headline: Healthcare Decisions Shouldn't Become Financial Burdens.
sections.copy: Health insurance policies differ in cover, exclusions, waiting periods, room-rent limits, co-payments, network hospitals, renewal terms and claim process. Ask the Lotus Capital team about the options available and read the insurer's policy documents before you decide.

sections.title: Overview
sections.copy: Comprehensive health insurance covers hospitalisation, treatment expenses, and modern medical procedures, shielding family savings during medical emergencies.

sections.title: Insurer Partners

sections.title: Comparison Checklist
items: Adequate sum insured and restoration benefit
Pre-existing disease waiting periods (typically 1 to 3 years)
Room rent sub-limits and proportionate deduction clauses
Empanelled network hospitals for cashless admission in Gujarat and nationwide
Specific disease exclusions and day-care treatment coverage
Claim settlement record and lifetime renewability

sections.title: How to Request a Quotation
steps: Send an enquiry specifying the age and medical history of family members.
Receive tailored plan comparisons with clear disclosure of waiting periods.
Review insurer policy documents and proposal form disclosures.
Complete payment directly with the insurer and receive policy documents.

sections.title: Claim Support Assistance
sections.copy: We assist clients with documentation, intimation, and query resolution during cashless requests and reimbursement claims.

sections.content: Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Cover is subject to insurer acceptance, policy wording, pre-existing condition declarations, waiting periods, and exclusions.
